references.text: The book of Genesis describes the law of purity, including handwashing, which can be seen as an early form of the traditions mentioned in Mark.
In the book of Psalms there are references to cleansing and purity that may relate to the ritual washings mentioned in Mark.
Matthew gives a parallel discussion about the Pharisees' traditions and handwashing, similar to what is mentioned in Mark.
In Isaiah, people are criticized for their superficial ritual cleansings, which can be seen in connection with the criticism Jesus gives in Mark.
